verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a Pulumi Cloud REST API, which the CLI itself uses for state, history and stack tags. It also ships a `pulumi api` command that can call any Cloud REST API endpoint, and an Automation API that exposes the IaC engine programmatically. Nothing in the evidence states that every UI action is available through the API, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity claim, published OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation that UI-only actions (org/team admin, settings) are reachable via API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Pulumi Cloud REST API is used by the Pulumi CLI to query and interact with state information, history, stack tags, etc.
The pulumi api command lets you call any Pulumi Cloud REST API
Automation API exposes the full power of infrastructure as code through a programmatic interface, instead of through CLI commands.
